rss_observations: The current library walks /review/list_rss/{numeric_reader_id} with shelf and page; its documented RSS page size is 100.
The implementation deliberately treats repeated-page termination differently from the reference library: it is PARTIAL, never COMPLETE.
Numeric author and reader IDs are distinct namespaces. A requested URL alone does not establish channel identity.
Reference fields include book_id, author_name, isbn, user_shelves, user_date_added, book_published, average_rating, user_rating, and nested book/num_pages.
Reference tests are generated examples, not an authenticated or live feed capture. OpenSearch totalResults support is standards-based and optional, not a claim that Goodreads currently emits it.

An inspected older public RSS file, https://github.com/octonion/goodreads/blob/1db5d47a16e1628d65a3a043ee93fc4c5cbd975e/xml/74.xml, was a quotes feed, not a bookshelf. It only corroborates channel and Atom self-link shape and is not accepted as bookshelf identity.
html_observations: Both published samples contain tr.bookalike.review and td.field.<name> with a nested div.value; one includes table#books and tbody#booksBody, the other is a bare table fragment.
Observed columns include title, author, isbn, isbn13, num_pages, avg_rating, num_ratings, date_pub, date_pub_edition, format, position, rating, shelves, and date_added.
Personal staticStars/staticStar.p10 or .p0 occur in field.rating. A separate field.shelves can contain visitor star controls; these must not be used as the shelf owner's rating.

The published samples do not establish the current authenticated navigation shell, empty-state markup, shelf-count labels, or pagination. Those contract scenarios are conservative synthetic wrappers around the grounded table layouts and require owner-authorized live validation.
fixture_policy: All local examples use synthetic reader IDs, book IDs, titles and authors. Structural excerpts were independently reduced; no user account, downloaded export, review text, credentials, or copied third-party full fixture is included.
live_only_gaps: Verify the current RSS channel reader link and shelf identity against an owner-selected public account; keyless per_page behavior is not claimed to have been live-tested.
Verify the private-account My Books/Profile identity shell, normal browser login renewal, genuine empty shelf count, and pagination against the owner's account.
Unknown or changed markup is not an empty shelf and cannot publish an authoritative complete result.
Access blocks and CAPTCHA challenges are surfaced and never bypassed.
